# <zbk-button>

The zebkit button: a light-DOM element wrapping a real `<button>`. It
renders the token-driven skeleton, forwards native semantics, adds a
focus-preserving loading state, and can govern retained content through the
`toggles` / `shows` / `hides` visibility family. Native `click` and platform
visibility events remain the public event surface.

Base class: `.zbk-button`. Variant classes: `.zbk-button--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-button-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- The user triggers an action: submit, confirm, open, dismiss, toggle a panel.
- Work is in flight after activation — `loading` announces it (aria-busy), suppresses re-activation, and keeps the button focusable.
- One button governs one or more retained same-tree regions — `toggles`, `shows`, and `hides` compile to platform visibility semantics.
- NOT Activation navigates to another URL. → An <a> element — buttons act, links navigate.
- NOT The control flips a persistent on/off setting. → zbk-toggle

## Guidance

- `type` defaults to "button" — the platform's "submit" default is a footgun inside forms; opt into submit explicitly.
- Prefer `loading` over `disabled` for in-flight work: unlike disabled, it keeps the button focusable so keyboard and screen-reader users don't lose their place mid-operation.
- `toggles`, `shows`, and `hides` take one or more target ids without `#`; the target's `hidden` attribute is the source of truth.
- Visibility changes emit cancelable `beforetoggle` then `toggle` on hidden-region targets; prevent `beforetoggle` when application state owns the mutation.
- Use native `commandfor` and `command` directly for application-owned commands; visibility verbs own invoker attributes for their targets.
- Style variants (ghost, outline, subtle) share one axis and are alternatives; size variants (sm, lg) compose with them: variant="ghost sm".

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `ZbkButtonType` | `"button"` | Forwarded to the native button; defaults away from implicit form submission. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Native disabled state: blocks interaction and removes the control from tab order. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Busy state: announces work and suppresses activation while preserving focusability. |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | — | Forwarded to the native button for form participation. |
| `value` | `string \| undefined` | — | Forwarded to the native button for form participation. |
| `form` | `string \| undefined` | — | Forwarded to the native button for form participation. |
| `command` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native invoker command forwarded when no visibility verb owns the relationship. |
| `commandfor` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native `commandfor` target id forwarded when no visibility verb owns it. |
| `toggles` | `string \| undefined` | — | Toggle every space-separated target id between its platform visibility states. |
| `shows` | `string \| undefined` | — | Show every space-separated target id without hiding an already visible target. |
| `hides` | `string \| undefined` | — | Hide every space-separated target id without showing an already hidden target. |
| `discover-toggled-element-timeout` | `number \| undefined` | — | Per-instance late-target discovery window in milliseconds; 0 diagnoses immediately. |
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | The button's label content (its accessible name). | required |
| `icon` | A supplementary pictogram rendered aria-hidden beside the label — any markup: svg, icon-font glyph, HTML character, image. | aria-hidden; sized by `icon-size`; data-position: start\\|end |

- `default`: Icon-only buttons must supply the accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby; dev mode warns when the computed name is empty.
- `icon`: Use data-position="start|end" for explicit placement; when omitted, placement is inferred from authored child order.
- `icon`: Icons inherit the label's ink (currentColor); there is no separate icon color token.
- `icon`: `icon-transform-expanded` can rotate or otherwise transform decorative disclosure icons when aria-expanded is true.
- `icon`: The icon is aria-hidden: it can reinforce the label, never replace it — meaning must live in the accessible name.

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space` — Activates the button; arrives as a native click (native behavior, preserved). Suppressed while loading.

## Options (behavior)

Named, defaulted decisions about what this component conveniently *does*, set under `components.button.options` in zebkit.config.json and carried into the browser by the generated runtime config module. `false` is the off switch for any of them. Precedence is one chain with no exceptions: **instance attribute > project config > zebkit default** — whatever the config decided, the markup outranks it.

| Option | Type | Default | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `discoverToggledElementTimeout` | `number` | `2000` | How long to watch for a visibility target that mounts after its trigger, in milliseconds; false or an instance value of 0 diagnoses immediately. |

## Composites

Visibility participant: **trigger** (action). Author one of `toggles="{id ...}"`, `shows="{id ...}"`, `hides="{id ...}"`. It may emit `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` according to the target mechanism. See [Visibility composites](composites.md) for target resolution, events, late mounting, and degradation.

## Events

No custom events. Native events (`click`, `change`, `input`, ...) bubble from the internal native element in light DOM — listen on the zebkit element.

## Examples

**Basic**

```html
<zbk-button>Save</zbk-button>
```

**Explicit submit in a form**

```html
<zbk-button type="submit">Create account</zbk-button>
```

type must opt into "submit" — zebkit defaults it to "button".

**Icon with label**

```html
<zbk-button variant="outline"><svg slot="icon" data-position="start" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M8 0 16 16H0z"/></svg>Save draft</zbk-button>
```

**Composed variants**

```html
<zbk-button variant="ghost sm">Cancel</zbk-button>
```

ghost (style axis) and sm (size axis) compose; two style-axis variants would conflict and warn.

**Loading**

```html
<zbk-button loading>Saving…</zbk-button>
```

aria-busy announces the in-flight work; activation is suppressed but focus is kept.

**Controlled content**

```html
<zbk-button toggles="details">More details</zbk-button><section id="details" hidden>Additional details.</section>
```

The retained target's hidden attribute supplies the initial state; the button adds platform ARIA and synchronizes aria-expanded.

**Native dialog command** (situational)

```html
<zbk-button commandfor="confirm-dialog" command="show-modal">Delete</zbk-button><dialog id="confirm-dialog">Confirm deletion</dialog>
```

The platform already spells dialog invocation, so command and commandfor pass through without Zebkit-managed hidden behavior.

**Icon-only** (situational)

```html
<zbk-button aria-label="Close" variant="ghost"><svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M2 2l12 12M14 2L2 14"/></svg></zbk-button>
```

Valid only with an aria-label supplying the accessible name; without one, dev mode warns.

**Button as navigation** (discouraged)

```html
<zbk-button onclick="location.href='/pricing'">Pricing</zbk-button>
```

Navigation belongs to <a>: middle-click, open-in-new-tab, and link semantics for AT are all lost.

**Conflicting command spellings** (discouraged)

```html
<zbk-button toggles="details" commandfor="dialog" command="show-modal">Open</zbk-button>
```

A visibility verb owns its invoker relationship; remove it when using an application-owned command.

## Variants

A variant is a named, partial remapping of the token surface compiled to a class. Apply via `variant="name other-name"`; different axes compose, same-axis variants are alternatives.

| Variant | Axis | Class | Description | Overrides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ghost` | style | `zbk-button--ghost` | Transparent canvas and border; ink takes the action role with a subtle hover wash. | canvas: transparent; canvas-hover: transparent; canvas-active: transparent; canvas-disabled: transparent; ink: {action.ink}; ink-hover: {action.ink-emphasis}; ink-active: {action.ink}; border-color: transparent; border-color-hover: transparent; border-color-active: transparent; border-color-disabled: transparent; box-shadow-hover: none; transform-hover: translateY(0) |
| `lg` | size | `zbk-button--lg` | Larger type and padding. | font-size: {font-size.md}; padding-inline: {spacing.lg}; padding-block: {spacing.sm}; icon-size: 1.5rem; border-radius: {border.radius-md}; line-height: {line-height.5} |
| `outline` | style | `zbk-button--outline` | Transparent canvas with an action-colored border; subtle wash on hover. | canvas: transparent; canvas-hover: {button.canvas}; canvas-active: {action.ink-inverse-emphasis}; canvas-disabled: transparent; ink: {action.ink}; ink-hover: {action.ink-emphasis}; ink-active: {action.ink-emphasis}; border-color: {button.ink}; border-color-hover: {button.ink-hover}; border-color-active: {button.ink-active}; ink-disabled: {disabled.ink-inverse-muted}; border-width: {border.width-sm}; border-radius: {border.radius-md}; border-color-disabled: {button.ink-disabled}; box-shadow-hover: none; transform: scale(1); transform-hover: translateY(0) scale(1); transform-active: scale(.9725) |
| `sm` | size | `zbk-button--sm` | Smaller type and padding; keeps the 44px minimum tap target. | font-size: {font-size.xs}; padding-inline: {spacing.sm}; padding-block: {spacing.xs}; icon-size: 1rem |
| `subtle` | style | `zbk-button--subtle` | Low-emphasis fill on the subtle action canvas; no border. | canvas: {app.canvas-muted}; canvas-hover: {app.canvas-muted}; canvas-active: {app.canvas-muted}; ink: {action.ink}; ink-hover: {action.ink-emphasis}; ink-active: {action.ink-emphasis}; border-color: transparent; border-color-hover: transparent; border-color-active: transparent; border-radius: {border.radius-md} |

Custom variants: add a `zbk-button.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "button": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-button--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-toggle>`.

## Resolved options in this project

What `components.button.options` resolves to here, carried into the browser by the generated runtime config module. An instance attribute always outranks these (GRAMMAR.md §11).

| Option | Value |
|---|---|
| `discoverToggledElementTimeout` | `2000` |
